headline: Atomos Brand Monitoring Report for November 19, 2026

coverage.summary: Announcement of Atomos Limited's Annual General Meeting scheduled for November 19, 2026, to be held virtually.

Atomos Limited's Annual Report highlights the release of seven new and upgraded products, including Ninja TX, Ninja TX GO, Ninja RAW, Shinobi 7 RX, Shogun AV-19, Sumo PRO 19, and the broader ecosystem range. The Sumo PRO 19 received multiple Best of Show awards at the NAB Show.

visibility_gaps: GPT retail/product sources are treated as unverified leads, not new verified social mentions.
methodology: The search was conducted using the specified criteria, focusing on Atomos brand mentions in the context of professional video production hardware, excluding unrelated topics. The search was limited to sources dated November 19, 2026, and included original articles, posts, and announcements from reputable platforms.
